items.title: Reply with decision on deferred compensation (bAV) offer
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns Ihre Entscheidung bitte binnen 10 Arbeitstagen ab dem Briefdatum mit.
items.computation: Letter is dated Tuesday 11.05.2027 ('ab dem Briefdatum'). Applying the standard civil-law counting rule for a period beginning with a specified day (§187 Abs. 1 BGB analogy): the letter date itself is not counted as day 1; counting of the 10 'Arbeitstage' (Mon-Fri, statutory holidays excluded, as defined in the letter) starts on Wednesday 12.05.2027. Business days: Wed 12.05 (1), Thu 13.05 (2), Fri 14.05 (3); weekend 15-16.05 skipped; Mon 17.05.2027 is Pfingstmontag (Whit Monday), a statutory public holiday in NRW, so it is skipped; Tue 18.05 (4), Wed 19.05 (5), Thu 20.05 (6), Fri 21.05 (7); weekend 22-23.05 skipped; Mon 24.05 (8), Tue 25.05 (9), Wed 26.05.2027 (10th Arbeitstag). So the 10th working day, and the deadline to notify the employer of the decision, is Wednesday 26.05.2027.

warnings: The exact start of the 10-Arbeitstage count is ambiguous: if the letter date (11.05.2027) itself is counted as the first working day instead of being excluded, the deadline would fall one working day earlier, on 25.05.2027 instead of 26.05.2027 — confirm the intended counting method with the employer if the exact day matters.
17.05.2027 (Pfingstmontag) is a statutory public holiday in NRW and was excluded from the working-day count.
